traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Do not confuse the Eightfold Path (practice) with the Four Noble Truths (theory).
The Path is often called 'Madhyama Pratipada' (Middle Way), avoiding extremes of self-indulgence and self-mortification.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Wisdom (Panna)

  • Right View
  • Right Resolve

Conduct (Sila)

  • Right Speech
  • Right Action
  • Right Livelihood

Mental Discipline (Samadhi)

  • Right Effort
  • Right Mindfulness
  • Right Concentration

Detailed Categorization

  • Wisdom (Panna)
    • Samma Ditthi: Right Understanding of Four Noble Truths
    • Samma Sankappa: Right Resolve to renounce and show compassion
  • Conduct (Sila)
    • Samma Vaca: Abstaining from lies/harsh speech
    • Samma Kammanta: Ahimsa (non-violence)
    • Samma Ajiva: Avoiding trade in weapons/slaves/intoxicants
  • Mental Discipline (Samadhi)
    • Samma Vayama: Developing wholesome states
    • Samma Sati: Awareness of body/mind
    • Samma Samadhi: Deep meditation (Jhana)
